textbookBox.concept: It told of an old lady who longed to go to Kashi, but who finally gave her savings to help an orphan girl's wedding, saying the girl's happiness mattered more.

beats.en: The narrator's grandmother, Krishtakka, whom she called Avva, had never been to school and could not read, so every Wednesday the narrator read the next episode aloud to her.
